scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools custom panel
the source category is All Commands
the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available commands list
the custom panel list contains one separator
"<Separator>" remains in the available commands list
the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available commands list again
the custom panel list contains two separator rows
"<Separator>" remains in the available commands list
the user double-clicks the first separator row in the custom panel list
one separator row remains in the custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
